notes.title: SAE Alpha 0.1.2: Release Notes
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.sae-game.com/post/sae-alpha-0-1-2-release-notes]Read Relese Noten on our Website[/url]

[h3]After receiving a lot of useful information and bug reports in the first week after the release of the Early Access version, the following things have been changed:[/h3]

[list]
[*]XP for breaking crystals reduced to 100 to 220
[*]Increased brightness in the jungle
[*]World border added so that you can no longer fall off the map
[*]Statistic "Coal Ores Mined" now works
[*]Increased Durability on Items:
Iron Axe: 60 → 100
Iron Dagger: 50 → 100
Iron Pickaxe: 60 → 100
Iron Shovel: 15 → 40
Stone Axe: 30 → 60
Stone Dagger: 30 → 60
Wooden Spear: 15 → 30
Simple Lighter: 5 → 20
Flashlight: 10 → 50
Hammer: 10 → 40
[*]Jumping into the water now works correctly and no longer deals fall damage
[/list]

notes.title: The time has finally come - the release of SAE!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]The time has finally come - the release of SAE![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/b29b53f38ade60624fbdddd74d639f43ed3777ca.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

Hello folks!

No, you have not misread! SAE is actually being released in [b]Early Access[/b] after a few delays!

[b]Mark the date in your calendars: January 14th, 2025![/b]

Yes, that's right, [b]only one month[/b] to go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/8351f7001d1ffa7defd4059e9b830a97eceda8e3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[h2][b]How much is still missing?[/b][/h2]

As you can easily see from the release date, [b]not much is missing[/b] for the Early Access release. Basically, everything that needs to be finished is finished; there are just a [b]few finishing touches to be made and tested![/b]

[h3][b]Wishlist now![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[h2][b]There will be more updates in the coming weeks![/b][/h2]

Of course, we don't want to withhold anything from you. That's why there will be more updates in the near future.[b][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[h2][b]Free postcard![/b][/h2]

To [b]celebrate[/b] this very important stage, we have decided to offer the [b]2024 Edition postcards for free![/b] This is because we no longer need them next year and there are still some left.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/3c8a571fc949198eec6a5b37fb37645a5e50ee2d.png[/img]

All postcards are [b]handwritten[/b] and can also be [b]SAE-stamped[/b] on request during the ordering process. Free of charge, of course!

[b][url=https://www.sae-game.com/product-page/personalized-sae-postcard-2024-series]Click here to get to our shop![/url][/b]

[b]So pick one up now for free; only while stocks last![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[h2][b]Get it before it's too late: Limited Edition Stingray Poster![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/16fd3499721a64a33018a2cccb61bdd0fabad20f.png[/img]

[b]We have spared no effort to create a new poster, limited to 20 copies.[/b] Get your hands on one of the few posters showing the development of the Stingray at SAE. The poster is in [b]A3 format (29.7 x 42.0 cm)[/b]. Printed on [b]high-quality, 250g/m2, glossy photo paper[/b] with vivid colors and crisp details. Our posters are sure to make a statement wherever they're displayed.

[url=https://www.sae-game.com/product-page/sae-stingray-development-poster][b]Click here to get one![/b][/url]

You too can decorate your room with a stingray!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[b]Thank You for reading![/b]
